3. **Priority** — these rules take precedence over any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The workflow, quality standards, and technical specifications in SKILL.md remain in effect; only interactive waits are skipped.

import json
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.gridspec as gridspec
import numpy as np
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# --- Color palette: editorial, muted, high-contrast for print ---
COLORS = {
    'Sub-Saharan Africa': '#C0392B',
    'South Asia': '#E67E22',
    'Europe': '#2980B9',
    'North America': '#27AE60',
}
REGION_ORDER = ['Sub-Saharan Africa', 'South Asia', 'Europe', 'North America']
BG_COLOR = '#FAFAFA'
GRID_COLOR = '#D5D8DC'
TEXT_COLOR = '#2C3E50'
ACCENT_GRAY = '#7F8C8D'

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 10,
    'axes.labelcolor': TEXT_COLOR,
    'axes.edgecolor': GRID_COLOR,
    'xtick.color': TEXT_COLOR,
    'ytick.color': TEXT_COLOR,
    'text.color': TEXT_COLOR,
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 16), facecolor='white')

# Use gridspec: top row for title, then 2×2 grid for panels, bottom for legend
outer = gridspec.GridSpec(3, 1, height_ratios=[0.08, 1, 0.05], hspace=0.15, figure=fig)

# Title area
title_ax = fig.add_subplot(outer[0])
title_ax.axis('off')
title_ax.text(0.5, 0.75, 'The Global Digital Divide: Internet Penetration Inequality in 2023',
              ha='center', va='center', fontsize=20, fontweight='bold', color=TEXT_COLOR,
              transform=title_ax.transAxes)
title_ax.text(0.5, 0.1,
              'Internet penetration rates (%) across income, age, geography, and region  |  Sources: ITU, World Bank, Pew Research Center',
              ha='center', va='center', fontsize=11, color=ACCENT_GRAY,
              transform=title_ax.transAxes)

# 2×2 inner grid
inner = gridspec.GridSpecFromSubplotSpec(2, 2, subplot_spec=outer[1], hspace=0.35, wspace=0.28)

# ============================================================
# PANEL A: Income Quintile — Slope chart (connected dot plot)
# ============================================================
ax_income = fig.add_subplot(inner[0, 0])
ax_income.set_facecolor(BG_COLOR)

quintiles = ['Q1\n(Lowest)', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4', 'Q5\n(Highest)']
quintile_keys = ['Q1 (Lowest)', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4', 'Q5 (Highest)']
x_q = np.arange(len(quintiles))

income_data = data['internet_by_income_quintile']['data']
for region in REGION_ORDER:
    vals = [d['penetration'] for d in income_data if d['region'] == region]
    ax_income.plot(x_q, vals, '-o', color=COLORS[region], linewidth=2.2, markersize=7,
                   label=region, zorder=3)
    # Annotate Q1 and Q5 values
    ax_income.annotate(f'{vals[0]}%', (x_q[0], vals[0]), textcoords='offset points',
                       xytext=(-18, -14 if vals[0] < 30 else 8), fontsize=8.5,
                       color=COLORS[region], fontweight='bold')
    ax_income.annotate(f'{vals[-1]}%', (x_q[-1], vals[-1]), textcoords='offset points',
                       xytext=(6, -4), fontsize=8.5,
                       color=COLORS[region], fontweight='bold')

# Highlight the Q1-Q5 spread for Sub-Saharan Africa
ssa_vals = [d['penetration'] for d in income_data if d['region'] == 'Sub-Saharan Africa']
ax_income.annotate('', xy=(4.35, ssa_vals[-1]), xytext=(4.35, ssa_vals[0]),
                   arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->', color=COLORS['Sub-Saharan Africa'],
                                   lw=1.5, shrinkA=2, shrinkB=2))
ax_income.text(4.55, (ssa_vals[0] + ssa_vals[-1]) / 2, f'{ssa_vals[-1] - ssa_vals[0]}pp\ngap',
               fontsize=8, color=COLORS['Sub-Saharan Africa'], ha='left', va='center',
               fontweight='bold')

ax_income.set_xticks(x_q)
ax_income.set_xticklabels(quintiles, fontsize=9)
ax_income.set_ylabel('Internet Penetration (%)', fontsize=10)
ax_income.set_ylim(-2, 105)
ax_income.set_xlim(-0.3, 5.2)
ax_income.yaxis.grid(True, color=GRID_COLOR, linewidth=0.6, alpha=0.8)
ax_income.set_axisbelow(True)
ax_income.set_title('A. Income Divide', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=12, loc='left')
ax_income.text(0.0, 1.02, 'Penetration by household income quintile',
               fontsize=9, color=ACCENT_GRAY, transform=ax_income.transAxes)
ax_income.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax_income.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# ============================================================
# PANEL B: Age Group — Grouped bar chart
# ============================================================
ax_age = fig.add_subplot(inner[0, 1])
ax_age.set_facecolor(BG_COLOR)

age_groups = ['15-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55-64', '65+']
age_data = data['internet_by_age_group']['data']
n_regions = len(REGION_ORDER)
bar_width = 0.18
x_age = np.arange(len(age_groups))

for i, region in enumerate(REGION_ORDER):
    vals = [d['penetration'] for d in age_data if d['region'] == region]
    offset = (i - n_regions / 2 + 0.5) * bar_width
    bars = ax_age.bar(x_age + offset, vals, bar_width, color=COLORS[region],
                      label=region, zorder=3, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)

# Annotate youth-elder gap for each region
for i, region in enumerate(REGION_ORDER):
    youth = [d['penetration'] for d in age_data if d['region'] == region and d['age_group'] == '15-24'][0]
    elder = [d['penetration'] for d in age_data if d['region'] == region and d['age_group'] == '65+'][0]
    gap = youth - elder
    offset_15_24 = (i - n_regions / 2 + 0.5) * bar_width
    ax_age.text(0 + offset_15_24, youth + 2.5, f'Δ{gap}',
                fontsize=7.5, color=COLORS[region], ha='center', fontweight='bold')

ax_age.set_xticks(x_age)
ax_age.set_xticklabels(age_groups, fontsize=9)
ax_age.set_ylabel('Internet Penetration (%)', fontsize=10)
ax_age.set_ylim(0, 115)
ax_age.yaxis.grid(True, color=GRID_COLOR, linewidth=0.6, alpha=0.8)
ax_age.set_axisbelow(True)
ax_age.set_title('B. Age Divide', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=12, loc='left')
ax_age.text(0.0, 1.02, 'Youth (15-24) vs. elderly (65+) gap shown as Δ above bars',
            fontsize=9, color=ACCENT_GRAY, transform=ax_age.transAxes)
ax_age.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax_age.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# ============================================================
# PANEL C: Urban-Rural — Dumbbell/lollipop chart
# ============================================================
ax_ur = fig.add_subplot(inner[1, 0])
ax_ur.set_facecolor(BG_COLOR)

ur_data = data['internet_by_urban_rural']['data']
y_ur = np.arange(len(REGION_ORDER))

for i, region in enumerate(REGION_ORDER):
    urban = [d['penetration'] for d in ur_data if d['region'] == region and d['setting'] == 'Urban'][0]
    rural = [d['penetration'] for d in ur_data if d['region'] == region and d['setting'] == 'Rural'][0]
    gap = urban - rural

    # Connecting line
    ax_ur.plot([rural, urban], [i, i], '-', color=COLORS[region], linewidth=3, alpha=0.4, zorder=2)
    # Rural dot
    ax_ur.scatter(rural, i, color=COLORS[region], s=120, zorder=4, marker='s', edgecolors='white', linewidth=1)
    # Urban dot
    ax_ur.scatter(urban, i, color=COLORS[region], s=120, zorder=4, marker='o', edgecolors='white', linewidth=1)
    # Gap annotation
    mid = (urban + rural) / 2
    ax_ur.text(mid, i + 0.28, f'{gap}pp gap', fontsize=9, ha='center', color=COLORS[region], fontweight='bold')
    # Value labels
    ax_ur.text(rural - 2, i, f'{rural}%', fontsize=8.5, ha='right', va='center', color=COLORS[region])
    ax_ur.text(urban + 2, i, f'{urban}%', fontsize=8.5, ha='left', va='center', color=COLORS[region])

ax_ur.set_yticks(y_ur)
ax_ur.set_yticklabels(REGION_ORDER, fontsize=10)
ax_ur.set_xlabel('Internet Penetration (%)', fontsize=10)
ax_ur.set_xlim(-5, 105)
ax_ur.xaxis.grid(True, color=GRID_COLOR, linewidth=0.6, alpha=0.8)
ax_ur.set_axisbelow(True)
ax_ur.set_title('C. Urban–Rural Divide', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=12, loc='left')
ax_ur.text(0.0, 1.02, '■ Rural  ● Urban — gap in percentage points',
           fontsize=9, color=ACCENT_GRAY, transform=ax_ur.transAxes)
ax_ur.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax_ur.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax_ur.invert_yaxis()

# ============================================================
# PANEL D: Overall Regional — Horizontal bar with population context
# ============================================================
ax_reg = fig.add_subplot(inner[1, 1])
ax_reg.set_facecolor(BG_COLOR)

overall_data = data['internet_overall_by_region']['data']
# Sort by penetration ascending for visual impact
sorted_regions = sorted(overall_data, key=lambda x: x['overall_penetration'])

y_reg = np.arange(len(sorted_regions))
for i, d in enumerate(sorted_regions):
    region = d['region']
    pen = d['overall_penetration']
    pop = d['population_millions']
    users = d['internet_users_millions']
    offline = pop - users

    # Full bar (population) in light gray
    ax_reg.barh(i, 100, height=0.55, color='#EAECEE', zorder=1, edgecolor='white')
    # Penetration bar
    ax_reg.barh(i, pen, height=0.55, color=COLORS[region], zorder=2, edgecolor='white')
    # Label
    ax_reg.text(pen + 1.5, i, f'{pen}%', fontsize=10, va='center', color=COLORS[region], fontweight='bold')
    # Population context on the right
    ax_reg.text(100, i - 0.3, f'{users:,.0f}M online / {pop:,.0f}M total',
                fontsize=8, va='top', ha='right', color=ACCENT_GRAY)

ax_reg.set_yticks(y_reg)
ax_reg.set_yticklabels([d['region'] for d in sorted_regions], fontsize=10)
ax_reg.set_xlabel('Internet Penetration (%)', fontsize=10)
ax_reg.set_xlim(0, 108)
ax_reg.xaxis.grid(True, color=GRID_COLOR, linewidth=0.6, alpha=0.8)
ax_reg.set_axisbelow(True)
ax_reg.set_title('D. Regional Overview', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=12, loc='left')
ax_reg.text(0.0, 1.02, 'Overall penetration with population context',
            fontsize=9, color=ACCENT_GRAY, transform=ax_reg.transAxes)
ax_reg.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax_reg.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# ============================================================
# Legend at bottom
# ============================================================
legend_ax = fig.add_subplot(outer[2])
legend_ax.axis('off')

legend_handles = [Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color=COLORS[r], linewidth=2.2, markersize=8,
                         label=r) for r in REGION_ORDER]
legend_ax.legend(handles=legend_handles, loc='center', ncol=4, fontsize=11,
                 frameon=False, handletextpad=0.5, columnspacing=2.5)

plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=180, bbox_inches='tight',
            facecolor='white', edgecolor='none', pad_inches=0.4)
plt.close()
print('Chart saved to /app/output/result.png')
